title: Story (per-story file) frontmatter
description: Structural contract for `_context/implementation/stories/story-NNN-<slug>-v{N}.md` (per-story files per Q4). Produced by Phase 7 `create-stories`; consumed by Phase 8 `dev-story` (one story → one dev session). Validated-distillate.

epic_ref.description: Epic ID this story belongs to.

ux_screen_refs.description: UX-spec screen names this story implements (front-end stories).

prototype_manifest_files.description: Files in prototype/{date}/ that this story extends or replaces (code-skeleton mode).

architecture_components.description: architecture.md component names this story touches.

archetype_granularity.description: Per Q5: thin=vibe-coder-lean (1-3h, AC); medium=standard (4-8h, BDD); rich=design-led/WDS (medium with UX+brand explicit).

items.description: Either AC strings (vibe-coder-lean) or 'Given/When/Then' BDD scenario lines (standard / WDS).

file_scope.description: File paths the story will create or modify.

dependencies.description: Other story IDs this story depends on (PERT chart input).

adrs_in_scope.description: ADR numbers that constrain this story's implementation.
